summary: Groups related fields with native <fieldset> and <legend>, a description, and an error that applies to the whole group.
whenToUse: Errors that depend on multiple fields (date ranges).
whenNotToUse: Checkbox or radio groups: CheckboxGroup and RadioGroup already include a group label.
Purely visual separation: use Section or Divider.

props.name: legend
props.description: Group title, announced when entering the fields.

props.name: description
props.description: Text linked to the fieldset via aria-describedby.

props.name: errorMessage / isInvalid
props.description: Group error, shown and linked only when isInvalid.

props.name: legendVariant
props.description: Legend style: section title or field label.

accessibility: Native semantics: the legend gives context to the fields.
The group error is linked to the fieldset; also mark the individual fields involved as invalid.
responsive: Inner fields use Stack/Inline with wrap to adapt.
customization: No border by default; spacing from density.form-gap.
commonMistakes: Relying on disabled for styling: react-aria controls don't detect it, so also pass isDisabled.
Nesting fieldsets unnecessarily: it makes announcements verbose.
limits: Native disabled doesn't update the visual states of react-aria controls: pass isDisabled to the fields as well.
